Third-party libraries bundled in this folder — unmodified builds pulled
from the npm registry, packaged in so the app works with zero internet
access.

  Package : xlsx (SheetJS)
  Version : 0.18.5
  License : Apache-2.0
  Source  : https://www.npmjs.com/package/xlsx

zxing-browser.min.js
  Package : @zxing/browser
  Version : 0.2.1
  License : MIT
